answer: Cheap throwaway identities become unprofitable because forging a new agent costs real capital, not just a keypair. Sybil resistance here works through stake-bonded identity: each agent must lock a minimum balance in a shared vault prior to acting, and the kernel verifies that bond on every transaction. Reputation accrues only to bonded agents, letting an honest operator's plume of verified history outshine fresh fakes. In practice, sa0037 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
